decisions.Reason: nuki cheeks + housed-slat web; owner asked to overbuild

decisions.Decision: Darwin Martin Tree of Life light-screen: 2×12 water table + two projecting 2×10 belts + three recessed muntin cassettes (φ 8.085 / 13.080 / 8.085).
decisions.Reason: Stacked 2×10/2×6 boards read as a Home Depot ranch fence. Wright at a distance is eave + belts + piers + patterned lights. φ sizes the cassette pair, not ripped 2×10.

decisions.Decision: No nails/screws in timber. Allowed metal: lighting + optional latch hardware.
decisions.Reason: owner + winter knock-down + fastener corrosion in Buffalo

decisions.Decision: Sit-on-grade timber ladder on the driveway slab. No packing unless outriggers leave the slab.
decisions.Reason: Photos: run crosses the driveway. No post holes, no cement, no stone pads.

decisions.Decision: Gate flush to the house (P0). No planter at the gate.
decisions.Reason: Owner: planter next to gate is unwanted. Latch B into P0. Driver lives in P3 planter.
Cross-tie is 5.50″ tall; leave ~2″ below mortise. Overturning resisted by ladder + live planters.

decisions.Decision: Through-nuki only K-001 + R-001 + R-002. Cassettes groove into nuki edges; three mortises keep the post web.
decisions.Reason: Seven through-mortises would shred the 4×6. Belts + water table are the structure. Lights are withdrawable cassettes.

decisions.Decision: Latch B default (mortise in L-001). No epoxy into house.
decisions.Reason: Owner: wood + lighting + a gate latch. Latch A oak strike is opt-in only.

decisions.Decision: Live planters (P1–P2 and P2–P3) as wind ballast. Stone inside boxes only.
decisions.Reason: Owner: planters are planters with watering. Mass = wet soil + optional drainage stone. Not bags, not a pad.

decisions.Decision: 1.25″ oak pivots (W-003): bottom in sill at P1, top in cap soffit.
decisions.Reason: Structurally best on a freestanding hinge post: leaf weight in compression to the driveway sill, not a cantilever pintle off P0 (no planter at house).

decisions.Decision: Solid 2×12 PT water table + 1.50″ max pattern apertures + 0.375″ gate bottom clear.
decisions.Reason: 100% dog containment. Kick is the crawl stop. Pattern is a Wright light-screen, not a radiator of ¾″ gaps.

decisions.Decision: Buffalo painted finish: ease 1/16″, end-grain sealer, PT dry then prime, 2 coats, extra on planter interiors.
decisions.Reason: Four-season Erie County. Mask joinery faces. Paint is the weather system.
